candidates.name: EvtOpenChannelConfig
verified_facts: Opens channel configuration for readback of enablement, isolation, retention, size, and access settings.
semantic_limits: Configuration readback is not a record-presence guarantee and no settings are changed in this evidence package.

candidates.name: EvtGetChannelConfigProperty
verified_facts: Reads a selected property from an open channel configuration handle.
semantic_limits: A property snapshot must be time-stamped and cannot prove the setting was unchanged during the recovery window.

candidates.name: EvtOpenPublisherEnum
verified_facts: Opens an enumeration of registered event publishers.
semantic_limits: Publisher registration is not proof that a provider emitted the expected recovery event.

candidates.name: EvtNextPublisherId
verified_facts: Returns publisher identifiers from a publisher enumeration.
semantic_limits: Enumerated identifiers require exact comparison and metadata readback; names alone are not ownership evidence.

candidates.name: EvtGetPublisherMetadataProperty
verified_facts: Reads a selected publisher metadata property from an open metadata handle.
semantic_limits: Metadata may be versioned or localized and must be correlated to provider GUID and binary identity.

candidates.name: EvtExportLog
verified_facts: Exports events selected from a channel or log file into an event log file.
semantic_limits: Export is a mutation and is documented only; no export is executed by this evidence publication.

candidates.name: EvtArchiveExportedLog
verified_facts: Archives localization resources with an exported log for later message rendering.
semantic_limits: Archiving does not validate source-event semantics or canonical F-host ownership and is not executed here.

candidates.name: EvtCancel
verified_facts: Requests cancellation of a pending operation on an event-log handle.
semantic_limits: Cancellation state is not success evidence and no live F-host operation is cancelled by this package.

candidates.name: EvtClose
verified_facts: Closes Windows Event Log handles returned by the API.
semantic_limits: Correct handle cleanup prevents leaks but does not prove event authenticity or recovery completion.

candidates.name: EVT_VARIANT
verified_facts: Carries typed scalar or array values returned by Windows Event Log APIs.
semantic_limits: Type, count, and null flags must be checked before interpretation; a value container is not semantic validation.

candidates.name: EVT_QUERY_FLAGS
verified_facts: Defines channel/file selection, direction, and tolerant-query behavior for EvtQuery.
semantic_limits: Flags affect query behavior and must be recorded; tolerant mode can conceal per-path errors if status is ignored.

candidates.name: EVT_RENDER_FLAGS
verified_facts: Defines XML, values, and bookmark render modes for EvtRender.
semantic_limits: Render mode must be explicit because output shape and interpretation differ by flag.

candidates.name: EVT_SUBSCRIBE_FLAGS
verified_facts: Defines subscription start position, bookmark handling, future-only mode, and tolerant-query behavior.
semantic_limits: An incorrect start flag can miss historical events or replay old records and therefore fails closed.
